cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Exactly as Planned
cards.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum found the surprise invitations. Right on schedule. You always stopped planning after the hiding part; watch the next bit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You told me to put them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And she found them herself. Good work. You're finally seeing why I made you think about who does the finding.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. She gets control; we look considerate. Your next job is to obey without looking relieved. You always gave that part away.
